title: Design System: Room Environment Safety Control

display.purpose: Reading number in an Overview tile.

headline.purpose: Page title; red attention line on Overview; section headings; Trends current values.

body.purpose: All running text and table cells; help text capped at 70ch.

label.purpose: Chips, table headers, legend, chart notes, ages, axis ticks.

shadows.name: input-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Text inputs on focus only; never elevation.

shadows.name: hollow-dot
shadows.purpose: Outlined status dot for unknown or not-fresh state.

motion.name: state-step
motion.purpose: State changes in one step (dot position, chip, row tint); no transitions or animation; reduced motion strips any that appear.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action on a form, such as Save on Patient limits.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Sign in or Show older events.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Green Ward Console"**

A calm clinical admin console. A deep ward-green sidebar frames white, softly rounded cards on a pale green-grey ground, and whatever needs the caregiver sits in a coloured attention row above everything else on every page. The page is read in one pass from the top: the attention row says what, how long, and now; the page's own content answers when and why below it.

Density is moderate and even: one 14px sans family with tabular figures, an 8px rhythm, hairline dividers inside cards, borders instead of shadows. Colour carries state and nothing else. Green means within the configured limits, amber means a hold timer is running or something waits to be acknowledged, red means alerting; muted grey means the value is not fresh. Every coloured mark sits beside words that say the same thing.

The system refuses decoration: no gradients, no glass, no elevation shadows, no ornamental charts, no decorative motion. State changes happen in one step.
keyCharacteristics: Ward-green sidebar, pale ground, white 14px-radius cards with a 1px border and no shadow.
One attention row on every page, tinted by the most urgent state, carrying its single action.
Three status tones (green, amber, red) plus grey for not-fresh; never colour without words.
One system sans family, tabular figures everywhere, sentence case, no letter-spacing.
Charts are inline SVG: mint limit band, gaps left visibly empty, outside-limit stretches drawn in red.

rules.name: The Three Tones Rule
rules.body: Status uses exactly three hues: Console Green within limits, Hold Amber while a timer runs or an action waits, Alert Red when alerting. No fourth status hue, and none of the three is used decoratively.

rules.name: The Words Beside Colour Rule
rules.body: A dot, chip, row tint or chart stretch never carries state alone. Chips always contain words ("Above limit · 12 s", "No limit set"); dots always sit beside a text label; red chart stretches carry a text label ("above limit · 12 s").

rules.name: The Grey Means Not Fresh Rule
rules.body: A retained, estimated-before-ready or missing value renders in Muted, its dot hollow, its tone dropped. A value is never shown in a tone colour unless it is a fresh reading.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no letter-spacing, no small labels above headings. A heading says what the card holds and stands alone.

rules.name: The Unit Stays With Its Number Rule
rules.body: A value and its unit, and a duration and its unit, are joined by a no-break space and never split across lines. A chip never wraps inside its pill; when space runs out it moves below the value whole.

rules.name: The Attention Row First Rule
rules.body: On every page the attention panel sits directly under the top bar, above all page content, and holds that state's one action. Nothing is placed above it.

rules.name: The Border Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels and controls separate from the ground by a 1px Card Border on white. box-shadow appears only as a focus ring or a dot outline, never as elevation.

dos: **Do** put the attention panel directly under the top bar on every page, with that state's single action in the row.
**Do** pair every status colour with words: chips contain text, dots sit beside a label, red chart stretches carry a label.
**Do** render retained, missing or not-yet-calibrated values in Muted with a hollow dot, never in a tone colour.
**Do** separate surfaces with a 1px Card Border on white and hairline dividers inside cards.
**Do** join every number to its unit with a no-break space, and keep chips on one line.
**Do** keep tabular figures on for all text.
**Do** change state in one step; honour reduced motion by removing any transition.
donts: **Don't** use box-shadow for elevation; it is reserved for the input focus ring and the hollow dot.
**Don't** use gradients, glass or blur, or ornamental chart fills.
**Don't** introduce a fourth status hue or use green, amber or red for decoration.
**Don't** set text in uppercase or with letter-spacing, and don't place small labels above headings.
**Don't** draw a chart line across missing data; leave the gap visible and labelled.
**Don't** add icons outside the navigation, and don't use glyph or emoji icons; navigation icons are stroked inline SVG.
